name: kitchen_sdk

boot_hooks._comment: Registers this SDK's bundled Afrikaans map for its manifest tr_keys into base_sdk's BundledTranslations registry at boot. Backend-served translation rows still win; the map is only the offline/unseeded fallback consulted before the humanized-key fallback. Requires a base_sdk with bundled_translations.dart.

_comment_tr_keys: Declared here rather than hand-written into base_sdk because only this SDK uses them - checked against base_sdk's 532 hand-written keys and against paas_driver's 122 app-local new keys, no collision either way. Keys needed by two or more SDKs belong hand-written in base_sdk instead, since the installer resolves a double declaration by silently keeping whichever it sees first.
